via.name: Blackburn Mine
via.quote: the site of the old Blackburn Mine

evidence: The track starts at Woolshed Creek car park at the end of Jig Road.
From the mine, the track climbs to a high point (trig R, 934 m) with superb views of the upper Ashburton Gorge, before descending to Woolshed Creek Hut.

evidence: There is a turnoff onto a 4WD track between Blackburn Mine and trig R. You can follow a 4WD track to Woolshed Creek Hut.

ways.label: Alternative route: Sidewinder Track to Blackburn Mine
evidence: This steep track provides an alternative route to the climb to Blackburn Mine.
The track then climbs steeply up to and through the tailings of the old Blackburn Mine, where it links with the main track to Woolshed Creek Hut.

ways.label: Optional circuit route: Woolshed Creek Hut to Woolshed Creek car park via Bus Stop and South Face tracks
evidence: There is the option of making a circuit by following the Bus Stop and South Face Ttacks.

From Woolshed Creek Hut, the track climbs 500 m to a local feature known as the Bus Stop Overhang. From here, the track crosses the face of Mount Somers to link with South Face Track (2 hr from the track start), which then follows a rocky ridge to Woolshed Creek car park.

doubts: No road end feature is in the packet, so the car park start has no ref. Main way recorded as one way (DOC distance '5.1 km one way'); the page also says day walkers can return to the hut the same way. The Sidewinder Track's start is not stated (only that it is an alternative to the climb to Blackburn Mine), so W3 start is null. W4 is recorded as the return leg hut to car park as its heading gives it; with W1 it forms a circuit. The 4WD track (W2) has no time or distance of its own ('about the same time').
